title: Dry-run batching verifier & VPC policy enforcer for safe cost-opt automation
creator: Aisha Romero
description: Goal: Ship a non-invasive 'dry-run' verifier and policy enforcement layer that allows the Optimize subsystem to propose batching/caching configuration changes for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments without directly applying risky changes. The verifier simulates throughput/latency/cost impact on historical traces and enforces org policies (via a pluggable policy engine) before suggestions are surfaced. We need safe defaults for offline environments (no outbound control-plane calls), a reversible plan apply that performs canary + automated rollback, and clear operator consent flows for air-gapped clusters.
background: Current Optimize pipelines produce batching and KV-caching recommendations that assume outbound connectivity and control-plane apply privileges. For Private/VPC/on-prem customers we must support: 1) offline evaluation and proposal generation, 2) local dry-run that validates config changes against node constraints and SLOs using historical traffic replays, 3) policy gates that prevent changes violating security/compliance rules (e.g., disabling encryption-at-rest, exceeding memory thresholds), and 4) a safe apply orchestration with automatic rollback and operator approval. Previous tickets touched on similar surface area but rely on cloud-hosted execution or simpler safe defaults; this task builds a hardened verifier + enforcer tailored to air-gapped and VPC deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Optimize can output a JSON 'plan' for batching/caching recommendations that includes simulated cost/latency deltas and a risk score (low/medium/high).
A dry-run mode exists which performs a replay on a configurable window of historical traces inside the Private environment without requiring outbound calls.
Policy engine integration prevents any plan that violates rules defined by an org-level policy bundle (e.g., memory caps, disabled KV-cache on regulated models).
Apply orchestration supports: canary apply to 5% of traffic, monitoring for regressions over 10 minutes, auto-rollback on defined regression thresholds, and a manual-approve fallback.
All config changes are logged to the local audit store and an operator-facing plan summary is produced with links to the exact diff and the simulated metric charts.
E2E tests covering offline dry-run, policy failure, successful canary apply, and auto-rollback are added to the CI pipeline for private deployments.
implementation_notes: Design a Plan JSON schema: metadata, proposed changes, impacted routes, simulation_results, risk_score, rollback_steps, audit_digest.
Replay engine: reuse runtime tracer + sample store to replay requests locally; limit replay window default to 30 minutes and allow operator override.
Policy engine: adopt OPA/Rego via a local conftest-style bundle; provide a default policy set for safe defaults (max_batch_size, max_kv_memory, disallowed_quantizations).
Offline constraints: the verifier must run in fully air-gapped mode. No external telemetry uploads. Use local metrics export (Prometheus file exporter) for simulation outputs.

Apply flow: orchestrator runs plan in 'dry-canary' endpoint group, applies batching/caching changes in memory-first mode (no immediate persisted config), monitors latency/cpu/memory and token-cost; if stable, persist; otherwise auto-rollback to previous in-memory config and persist a failed plan.
Rollback mechanics: store prior config snapshot in local secure store before any apply; ensure cryptographic integrity (HMAC) and include reason codes in audit logs.

Operator UX: produce human-readable summary with risk indicators, estimated monthly cost delta, and simple accept/reject CLI + Console flows. For air-gapped Console, surface downloadable plan artifact and a signed apply token for manual execution.
Telemetry & alerting: when running canary, emit regression metrics to local alerting rules; add a Dashboard template for 'Plan Execution' in the Console that works in Private deployments.
Edge cases: if KV cache warming cannot complete in canary window, mark plan as 'needs longer warmup' and require manual approval.

notes: This ticket must coordinate with the Private deployment SRE on config persistence APIs and the security team for policy bundles. The plan artifact must be exportable and importable across clusters to support multi-cluster enterprises.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: A faulty batching recommendation could cause outage or cost spike. Mitigation: require canaries + short monitor window + automated rollback and manual approval for high-risk plans.
Risk: Offline mode may provide incomplete telemetry leading to bad simulations. Mitigation: conservative safe defaults and explicit 'needs longer warmup' state that forces manual review.
Risk: Policy bypass due to misconfiguration. Mitigation: ship with enforced default policies and include policy compliance tests in CI.
